newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Jan 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Jan 20.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on January 20. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The National Election Committee will officially release on Monday its provisional list of 2,303 legislature candidates for the May 29 election.

Mines and Energy Minister Ida Bagus Sudjana said over the weekend that the government would not raise domestic fuel prices despite the fact that the expected higher prices of crude oil would push up fuel production costs.

Indonesian officials warned on Sunday that heavy rains could wash large amounts of cold lava down on residential areas bordering Central Java and Yogyakarta provinces as Merapi volcano showed no signs of calming.

The Capital Market Supervisory Agency (Bapepam) plans to summon brokerage firm PT Lippo Securities on Monday after the disappointing share performance of the agribusiness firm PT Sierad Produce. Lippo was the underwriter for the listing of Sierad on the local stock exchanges late last December.

The government, as stipulated in a presidential decree issued in February 1996, offers tax facilities only for Timor sedans produced by PT Timor Putra Nasional, and not to other types of cars including Timor jeeps, director general of metal, machine and chemical industries Effendi Soedarsono said.
